record.question: Consider the following figures : In the figures (I) to (VI) above, some parts are shown to change their positions in regular directions. Following the same sequence, which of the figures given below will appear at (VII) stage?
options: Triangle in the upper-left sector; square in the lower-right sector.
Square in the top sector; triangle in the lower-left sector.
Square and triangle together in the bottom sector (square left, triangle right).
Triangle in the top sector; square in the bottom sector.
record.explanation: The square advances one sector clockwise at every step: top, upper-right, lower-right, bottom, lower-left, upper-left, then top again. The triangle advances one sector anticlockwise: lower-left, bottom, lower-right, upper-right, top, upper-left, then lower-left again. Thus figure VII has the square at the top and the triangle in the lower-left sector. This matches printed option B; the exact final-key cell for this booklet also records B.
